name: Create tag
description: Creates a tag catalog entry for a supported entity type.
whenToUse: Create a new tag catalog entry with name, color, and immutable entity_type for a supported entity (mutating).

fields.name: entity_type
fields.description: Required on create. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The tag name. Unique per company and entity type, including archived tags.

fields.name: color
fields.description: The tag color as a 3 or 6 digit hex value, or null to clear it.
